notes.title: patch 0-2-2b: Skirmish and Big Base
notes.content: [p]This patch includes 2 new game modes, and a bunch of bug fixes. There's a new practice mode: Big Base, and Skirmish mode. Added some info about our upcoming DLC: Super Ace![/p][p][/p][p]New Features:[/p][p]-- Big Base: new practice mode where you and your opponent start with a large base and a bank of resources, but there's nothing to mine off of the map. Practice building and controlling a large army.[/p][p]-- Skirmish mode makes it easy to play standard matches against the AI. [/p][p][/p][p]Bug Fixes:[/p][p]-- Rust Outlaw: Turbo was setup wrong and was uncastable.[/p][p]-- Rust Champion: Treads were animating backwards.[/p][p]-- Some projectiles were not spawning visual effects if they impacted the edge of the map.[/p][p]-- Sandbox mode would occasionally not stop matches properly.[/p][p]-- Sandbox mode would incorrectly list an opponent when there was none.[/p][p]-- Some options weren't taking effect until after the option panel was opened.[/p][p][/p][p]Other Changes:[/p][p]-- Keyboard hotkey presses now make UI sounds and are visible on the command card.[/p][p]-- Improved materials on some city-buildings (visible via arena-cam).[/p][p]-- Handful of small changes to the new menus.[/p][p]-- Some changes to opponent AI, they're better at base layouts, they scout more often, and they are more efficient with their inputs.[/p][p]-- Leaderboards: now properly show the last-seen value.[/p]

notes.title: Patch 0-2-2a: Revamped unit models & new menus
notes.content:
This patch features new menus, reworks of all unit models, and a big change to team colors. There is also a new Neon unit, the Photon. Another big addition is clickable props, objects in the world that modify or move your camera (you can turn them off in the options menu). It's been a few months, so there are many small changes & bug fixes as well. 


* We also have a release schedule:
-- July - 08 - 2025 : Patch 0.2.3a

-- September - 09 - 2025 : Patch 0.2.4a
---- Final patch of the Beta

-- October - 07 - 2025 : Patch 0.9.0a
---- Release Candidate

-- October - 13 - 2025 : Patch 0.9.1a
---- Next Fest

-- November - 11 - 2025 : Patch 1.0.0a
---- Release


New Features:
-- All menus have been replaced.
-- Changed team colors from Light vs Dark to Blue vs Red
-- Improved and replaced all unit models for all 3 factions
-- New Unit: Neon Photon, scouting unit
-- New clickable-props:
---- Arena Cam: Click to swoop into the map and view battles up-close!
---- Back to Base: Click to jump back to your starting location


Gameplay Changes:
-- Reworked unit destruction process
---- Destroyed units may spawn debris that can damage other units
-- Neon Worker
---- Reordered building hotkeys
-- Neon Cyber Tower
---- Cost: 40 Mojo + 40 Copper -> 30 Mana + 30 Mojo
---- New ability: produce Photon
---- Removed Infect ability
---- Removed Radar Scan ability
-- Neon Zapper: renamed to Infector
---- Zap ability: removed & replaced with Infect
---- Infect spreads a virus among enemy units, and eventually stuns them all
---- Super Infector upgrade: Infector's Virus becomes a Mind-Control effect
-- Neon Amulet: removed Infect ability
-- Neon Talon: reduced Turn Timers
-- Marble Ace:
---- Weapon Type: Instant (laser) --> Missile
-- Marble Lance: New EMP Dash ability
---- Become a torpedo and crash, damage and stun units in a large area
---- Lance is destroyed
-- Rust Guardian:
---- Weapon: Plasma shots --> Instant (bullet)
-- Rust Outlaw:
---- Power shot ability: replaced with Fire Bottle
---- Max 1-time use ability, deal area damage
-- Rust Champion:
---- Weapon Firing-Count: Double slow --> Double Instant
---- Turn Timers increased


Bug Fixes:
-- Talons no longer try to pick up Defense Drones in aerial mode
-- Reflection camera should be much more stable
-- Steam Leaderboards properly show last-seen value
-- Rally points drawers are not messed up by de-selecting the unit


Other Changes:
-- More terrain material changes
-- New props outside of the stadium
-- New Victory Panel / Animation
-- Improved animations of Neon Talon and Marble UFO teleport abilities
-- New V-Sync, screen resolution, and ground-unit smoothing options
-- A bunch of units use new Treads animations
-- Many units received engine particle-effects
-- Casting bars now have tooltips
-- More interface & hud sound effects
-- Neon Bit Cannon Weapon Type: bullet --> laser
-- Neon Fighter: Changed weapon sound effects (again)
-- Sandbox: improved the cheats panel & added research-upgrade cheats


* This patch contains gameplay changes, and cannot run replays from version 0.2.1 or earlier.

notes.title: 0-2-1a: New Map Enviornments, Resource Patches, and more!
notes.content:
First patch of the Beta! Just in time for the Steam Real-Time Strategy Fest! The Supporter's Badge is half price for the week!

This patch focused on usability & environments. 6 new Map-Environments are in the game now, with all kinds of new terrains, props, and doodads.

New Features:
-- New resource patch models
-- Your opponent's buildings will now leave a ghost behind when your units can no longer see them.
-- Sandbox mode
---- Reworked cheats interface
---- Can now use cheats to spawn resource patches
---- Added gameplay speed controls 

Gameplay Changes:
-- Removed Mojo cost from the new 'Emergency' produce unit abilities.
---- These are still intended to only be used in a pinch, most of the time it's best to make units in batches.
---- Production times increased for some.
-- Resource patches that are out of vision can no longer be selected.
-- Neon Magnetar: Cost increased
---- 100 Steel + 60 Copper -> 100 Steel + 100 Copper
---- Weapon Stop & Fire times: 8 frames -> 5
---- Weapon Cooldown: 35 frames -> 33
---- Agent Accel: 27 -> 40
---- Production batch size: x3 -> x2
-- Rust Champion: Cost increased
---- 90 Iron + 102 Army Kits -> 150 Iron + 95 Army Kits
---- Max Health: 43 -> 50
---- Repair Ability Energy Cost: 40 -> 30
---- Shell: Energy: 20 -> 50, Duration 0.5 -> 2.0
-- Rust  Mortar Car : Volley Ability Reworked
---- Energy 75 -> 60, Damage: 9 -> 8, Range: 23 -> 25, Stop & Fire Time: 10 -> 3


Bug Fixes:
-- Resource patches mining out is no longer visible through Fog of War

Other Changes:
-- Fighter weapon now looks different than Super Fighter weapon
-- Improved priorty settings on sound effects.

-- Switched around some visual effects so they match their assoiciated unit better.


* This patch contains gameplay changes, and cannot run replays from version 0.2.0 or earlier.

notes.title: 0-2-0a: The BETA begins
notes.content:
Alpha complete! We've entered the Beta phase of Early Access, we're down to the last handful of important features still left to do!

New Features:

-- Match-making rating (MMR)
---- Used in Quick Match
---- New Leaderboards
---- MMR Tiers (F, E, D, C, B, A, and S)

-- Added Steam achievements

-- Added the Supporter's Badge
---- If you want to help the development of Neon Marble Rust, consider this!
---- Simple cosmetic that will appear next to your cores in online matches

-- Added dynamic cursors

-- Use Alt-I to toggle the interface, helpful for screen shots

Balance Changes:
-- Reworked how splash damage is applied.
---- Air and ground units are now separated; one damage source cannot both air and ground units

-- Neon Lightning Tower:
---- Weapon now deals chain damage to a second target
---- Removed Lightning Bolt ability
---- New Ability: Extra Zap
----- Costs 20 Energy
----- Applys boost to next weapon attack
----- Boost: Weapon chains to a third target and stuns all enemies hit.

-- Marble Fission Cannon
---- Removed self-damage
---- Weapon range reduced: 19 -> 17
---- New Ability: Overcharge
----- No energy cost
----- Applys boost to next weapon attack
----- Boost: Weapon gains +2 range, deals instant damage, chains to 2 targets, but deals self-damage (20% remaining)

-- Rust Wagon
---- Removed siege/un-siege energy cost

-- Rust Mortar Car
---- Removed siege/un-siege energy cost
---- Reduced weapon range: 23->21
---- Reduced weapon energy cost: 25 -> 20
---- Reduced weapon damage: 10 -> 9

Fixes:
-- Defense Drone can now use ability while in the air

-- Reworked music system, improved loading times & music now plays in menus

-- Increased ambient lighting 

-- Improvements to terrain materials

-- Most visual-effects are now thinner/dimmer/quicker. Things should be less chaotic during battles now.

-- Survivors mode: added a delay so you don't accidentally pick an upgrade

-- Mind-control virus now uses correct tooltip-type

* This patch contains gameplay changes, and cannot run replays from version 0.1.12 or earlier.

notes.title: 0-1-10a2: New Neon unit models, tech rework, and more
notes.content:
New unit models, single-player progression, and a big tech rework are the big features in this patch. Some of the new models were implemented in the last patch a few weeks ago, but now all Neon units and buildings have updated models. Copper and Halogen units are now more distinct, and it should be easier to tell which team each unit is on.
The big tech rework was to swap the Fighter and the Razorback in the Neon Tech Tree. The Fighter is better suited for that iconic early-game role, and the Razorback fits well on the Halogen side. Also, all Neon unit production structures have been made more powerful, they are now either cheaper or produce units at a higher rate, this means more units and bigger battles!

New Features:
-- Complete challenges in the practice mode to unlock new units to try out!
-- New Neon unit models, textures, effects, and animations
-- Under-the-hood changes to map environments, another big step towards custom maps!
-- 10v10 mode has a new, much smaller map.

Balance Changes:
-- Neon Defense Drone:
---- Cost: 20 Mojo + 30 Iron -> 20 Mojo + 40 Iron
-- Neon Talon:
---- Removed Shields
---- Increased rate of damage from Dash ability
-- Neon Fighter: 
---- Producer: Arcade -> Fighter Bay
---- Cost: 60 Mana + 40 Halogen -> 70 Mana + 30 Steel
-- Neon Razorback:
---- Producer: Razor Bay -> Arcade
---- Cost: 50 Mana + 50 Steel -> 60 Mana + 40 Halogen
-- Neon Razor Bay: 
---- Renamed to Fighter Bay
---- Cost: 90 Mana + 90 Steel -> 60 Mana + 60 Steel
---- Production Rate: 8/sec -> 6.7/sec
-- Neon Arcade:
---- Cost: 90 Halogen + 90 Steel -> 60 Halogen + 60 Steel
---- Production Rate: 5.7/sec -> 8/sec
-- Neon Factory:
---- Production Rate: 6.7/sec -> 10/sec
---- Production Rate (Magnetar): 8/sec -> 12.8/sec
-- Neon Refinery:
---- Purify Halogen: Batch Size: 30 -> 40, Time: 10s -> 12.5s

Bug Fixes:
-- Fixed bug that caused transports to pick up enemy units
-- Survivors mode: Fixed issue that caused duplicate bonuses

Other Changes:
-- Improved the 'flashing' materials, which is applied to stunned and destroyed units.
-- Added recoil animation to BitCannon weapon
-- Added animation to Zapper so its arms go up and down
-- Units should move a bit more smoothly now, especially at high frame rates

* This is a gameplay patch, so this version is not able to run replays from any previous 0-1-9 build.

notes.title: 0-1-9a: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Network match desyncs became a big issue recently, these should be mostly fixed now. We've also started reworking and improving graphics; new models, animations, lighting and a lot more to come.

New Features:
-- Improved some Neon unit models
---- Worker, Mana Core, Zapper, Amulet, Magnetar, Factory
-- New Mangentar weapon animation


Bug Fixes:
-- Fixed more issues related to desyncs
---- A lot of these issues stem from rollbacks. NeonMarbleRust uses a two-state rollback system, and sometimes the ordering that game logic is applied to units could be changed by a rollback.
---- These issues are mostly fixed now, but just to be sure it isn't an issue, the input delay has been increased. 
-- Fixed lots of small issues in Survivors Mode
-- Improved RNG
---- Sometimes the old RNG was not returning consistently random numbers. In survivors mode, the same handful of unit types would keep coming up.


Other Changes:
-- Survivors Mode: only the MiniBots count for xp and leveling.
-- Starting workers are now spread out a bit more
---- Alleviates some balance issues based on where resource patches are relative to the Core.
---- (standard game modes: Sandbox, BuildQuota, NetworkMatch)


* This is a gameplay patch, so this version is not able to run replays from any previous 0-1-8 build.

notes.title: 0-1-8a: New game mode: Survivors
notes.content:
This patch features a new single-player game mode called 'Survivors', there's a rework of the Mojo Tower, and online matches that lose synchronization will now pause and re-run the game, to try to resync.


New Features:
-- New single-player game mode: Survivors
---- Survive as long as you can! Destroy 10 enemy units to Level Up, each level brings a set of random upgrades or units to choose from.
---- Features swarms of new Neon MiniBot units


Balance Changes:
-- Neon Mojo Tower: Energize ability
---- Reworked: Can now be automated.
---- Energy Generated: 50 -> 6
---- Mojo Cost: 100 -> 15
---- Energy Cost: 14 -> 8
---- Cast Time: 1s -> 10s
---- Impact Radius: 4 -> 7

-- Neon Worker: Build RazorBay
---- Cost changed: Iron + Steel -> Mana + Steel
---- Now costs the same resources as the Razorback, also is a bit easier to get in the early game.

-- Move Speed Upgrade
---- Now reduces turn timers
---- Air units were incorrectly getting +10% increase, is now +5%

Bug Fixes:
-- Fixed rare bug that could cause a desync after a rollback
-- Added protections against lag-spikes caused by pathfinding
-- Ground units switch from obstacle-avoidance to pathfinding more easily


Other Changes:
-- Some unit weapons animations that use a disc have been improved.
-- The tooltip for Neon Talon: Dash now shows energy cost
-- When resource patches are mined out, they will properly spawn the UnitKill explosion


* This is a gameplay patch, so this version is not able to run replays from any previous 0-1-7 build.

notes.title: 0-1-7a: Bug fixes & Clean up
notes.content:
More bug fixes and lots of little things cleaned up in this patch.

New Feature:
-- Added troubleshooting tool to start-screen
---- Shift + C + Escape -> brings up a dialog to clear player preferences

Balance Changes:
-- Defense Drone:
---- Ability renamed: Dot Mines
---- Ability now casts instantly
---- Mine projectiles move faster
-- Worker:
---- Build Transmuter: Energy cost: 20 -> 25
-- Invasion:
---- Now applies to transporter units, gives drop-unit command
---- No longer applies to units on hold-position

Bug Fixes:
-- Harvest Mode: now ends properly, and displays destroyed core counts
-- Units no longer get stuck outside attack range
-- Workers no longer restart mining when reclicked
-- Launch projectile abilities:
---- Fighter, Defense Drone, Mojo Tower
---- These abilities will now fire when out of range
-- Amulet: Null Blocks
---- Does a better job spreading out the blockers

Other Changes:
-- Unit destruction effect adjusted
---- Explode a bit earlier

notes.title: 0-1-6a: New 'Invasion' Ability
notes.content:
Lots of small features and bug fixes this time...

New Features:
-- Neon Mojo Tower: 
---- New Ability: Invasion
---- Costs 100 Mojo
---- Order all army units to attack!
---- Great Mojo-Option for players who don't want to use so many control-groups, but your opponent will know the invasion is coming!

-- Produce-Unit Ability: Double Click
---- Before placing a produce-unit order, you can double-click the hotkey instead to make the unit where the previous unit was made. This allows players to remake units while not looking at their base.

Balance Changes:
-- Transport units will now search for a spot to drop off units, if the target is blocked.

-- Neon Talon:
---- Reworked Dash ability: Now damages nearby enemies for a few seconds

-- Slight change to how multiple Stuns or Buffs stack on single unit. When a unit is already stunned, additional stuns would reset the duration, instead those additional stuns will extend the duration. 

-- Neon Razorback: 
---- Barrier Charge: Cooldown reduced: 1 sec to 1/4 sec
---- Hitting the ability multiple times will cause the buff duration to extend

-- Neon Magnetar:
---- Weapon: Stun duration reduced: 20 -> 12

-- Neon Zapper:
---- Zap: Stun duration reduced: 20 -> 15

-- Marble Enforcer:
---- Stun Gun: Stun duration reduced: 30 -> 20

Bug Fixes:
-- Fixed issue where large units would occasionally fail to find paths.
-- Fixed issue where ground units would incorrectly receive orders to move to unwalkable areas.
-- Fixed issue caused by multiple transports picking up a unit at the same time.

Non-Gameplay Changes:
-- Neon Fighter: Weapon effect now has 1 blast
-- Reworked the Start Screen, now has stadium in the background
-- When units are destroyed, the explosion now fits the unit's size better


* This is gameplay patch, so this version is not able to run replays from any previous 0-1-5 build.

notes.title: 0-1-5a: More new units!
notes.content:
Another new patch! With 4 more units this time. Things will slow down a bit, as we shift gears towards promoting the game more. Expect the next patch sometime in March. Like the last couple of patches, it will feature 2 more Marble and 2 more Rust units, which will bring the total to 6 of each. Like Neon, Marble and Rust will each have 8 combat units, so the full release of all 3 houses will be soon!


New Features:

-- New Units

---- Marble Fission Cannon: Long-range/ siege unit. Its weapon is unstable and may damage itself!

---- Marble Paragon: Healer unit, needs to 'siege-up' to enter healer mode.

---- Rust Scrap Bot: Cheap Melee Unit.

---- Rust Guardian: Defensive Unit.

-- Sandbox Mode

---- New Add-Resources cheat

Balance Changes:

-- Neon Mojo Tower:
---- Lightning ability now fires instantly (used to have a half-second cast time)

-- Neon Zapper & Marble Enforcer:

---- Stun ability: Fixed bug that caused these units to fail to get in range of their target.


Changes:

-- Pausing has been added to all single-player game modes.

-- Added an APM counter (on right-hand side of the screen). Counts networked 'commands' as well as camera-movements and paging through the command card.

-- Harvest Mode: Waves 1, 2, and 3 now spawn an enemy ManaCore on the edge of map. Like other game modes, when the player destroys one, they get a point added to their score. The game ends when your opponent has more points than you, so taking out these ManaCores can give you 'extra lives'!


* This is gameplay patch, so this version is not able to run replays from any previous 0-1-4 build.

notes.title: 0-1-4b: First Marble and Rust units!
notes.content:
0-1-4b :: Neon Marble Rust is a new Real-Time Strategy game featuring 3 factions: Neon, Marble, and Rust. Until now, Neon was the only faction available for play. In this patch, 2 Marble units and 2 Rust units are now available. Players can find these units in the Sandbox Mode by using the Spawn Units cheat. These new units are also available in the Break-The-Targets and 10vs10 practice modes.

New Features:

-- Marble Enforcer: Defender unit with a stun ability.

-- Marble Lance: Fast and durable ranged army unit.

-- Rust Chopper: Air Transport unit, armed with a missile launcher.

-- Rust Raptor Coil: Area damage specialist unit.

Changes:

-- Reworked Practice Mode menu

-- Reworked HUD

---- New background images

---- Changes color based on the user's team (light or dark)

---- New weapon sprites on the selected unit panel; shows the selected unit firing its weapon

-- Changed smoke material on some particle effects

-- Adjusted juice FX for some weapons; added particle effects, adjusted sounds

---- Defense-Drone, Fighter, Magnetar, Amulet

-- Reworked MiniMap and MapPreviews

---- Now longer uses a rendered image of the map.

---- This is a slight down-grade, but was a major hurdle toward implementing custom maps.

-- PracticeModes now show score at the top of the screen

Bug Fixes:

-- Fixed issue with ordering of replay files in the replay menu

-- Correct floating text for constructing a Razor Bay

-- Damagers now impact the outside of its target's mesh

-- MiniMap is no longer transparent in the HUD

-- Fixed issue with units jittering while casting abilities

-- Fixed issues with Observers (replays and multiplayer)

---- Observer can now select 20 units, of either team

---- RidKey (deselect 1 unit) now works for observers

* This is non-gameplay patch, so this version is able to run replays from any previous 0-1-4 build.

notes.title: 0-1-4a: New Practice Mode
notes.content:
New Features:
-- BuildQuota practice mode
---- Build 10 units as quick as you can. Great for learning build orders.
---- You are given more workers and/or more time to make higher tech units.
-- Reworked GameModeSelect menu
-- Added a 'ShowErrorMessages' option to the options menu
-- Added an fps counter to the gameplay HUD
-- 

Balance Changes:
-- Talon Dash ability rework:
---- Now deals 9 damage to a random enemy near the target location.
---- Used to deal 3 damage to all units near the target, including itself. There was potential for the self damage to be interesting as it triggered the unit's shields, but it didn't work out.
-- SpawnUnitsCheat (sandbox mode only) now spaces units out better when spawning multiple units.

Bug Fixes:
-- Zapper's Stun ability now spawns FX properly.
-- Added hotkeys to the new ability tooltips (added in 0-1-3)
-- When a transporter was destroyed while carrying a unit, there was a chance it would leave the unit in the air. This is fixed, the carried unit will now be destroyed after the carrier.
-- Fixed bugs related to vision when Transporters pick up units.
-- Fixed issues with multiple transporters trying to pick up a unit on the same frame.
-- Simple Right-Click on an enemy unit will now give an attack order. Telling a unit to follow an enemy unit without attacking is no longer possible.
-- Fixed issues with air units not properly reaching a FollowUnit target
-- Disabled HoldPosition button from the command card for units that can't move (buildings).
-- Stop command now properly removes rally from unit production buildings.

* This is gameplay patch, so this version is not able to run replays from any previous 0-1-3 build.

notes.content:
First patch!

For Neon Marble Rust patches will increment the last section of the version name, Z in X-Y-Z. Patches will feature gameplay changes, and will have some limitations:
 - Not be able to run replays of previous versions
 - Will not connect to players using previous versions

New Features:
 - Replay Support
 --- After matches, you will be able to save a replay.
 --- Replay watching is available from the Game Mode menu
 --- Replays are pretty limited for now
 ----- If there are features you would like to see, you can send feedback on social media!
 --- Replays are only available for Sandbox and Online modes

 - Can now enable opponent AI in Sandbox Mode
 --- AI will send their units to look for your base, and will attack when the find you.

 - While Observing an online match or a replay, the camera is zoomed out a bit.


Game-Play Changes in 0-1-3:
 - New Ability: Hold Position
 --- Any unit that can move can now be given a Hold-Position command
 --- Bound to H key
 --- Units won't move, but will attack nearby enemies

 - Workers
 --- When a worker is in its own way when trying to build, they now automatically move out of the way.
 *** If other units are in the way, this will not move those units.
 - Added more resource patches to Harvest Mode map
 --- Was a bit too challenging around 8 minuets or so

- Air Units
--- Fixed bug where the unit would stop just out of attack range


Bug Fixes:
 - Fixed issue with Harvest Mode ending unexpectedly
 - Fixed graphical issue with reflections
 - Adjusted the HUD so it fit better on larger resolutions
 - Online-Room countdown now shows properly
 - Dark-Team selection boxes are now easier to see
 - Fighter weapons are now drawn with correct timing
 - Online-Rollbacks no longer spawn multiple instances of unit models
 - Player names now show up correctly in Online matches
 - Lots of small fixes!
